spotlightStoryMetadata.llmDescription: This NBA highlight features Jordan Poole hitting a buzzer-beating half-court shot during a game. The video then cuts to a post-game interview where Poole discusses his mindset, recalling a similar play he made before. It includes footage of him making a long-range shot from near the free-throw line.
